jobs.title: Junior Compute Architect
jobs.description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Hardware organisation at Fractile
Processor Architecture sits within Fractile’s hardware organisation, which owns everything from compute engine definition and ISA design through memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and the path from early architectural exploration through to tapeout and post-silicon validation. Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon.

About the team and role
As an Early Career Processor Architect, you’ll join our architecture team to learn how to define the compute engines, ISA definitions and programming models that sit at the heart of our silicon. Working closely with senior architects and our logical design, physical design, and verification teams, you’ll get real exposure to performance modelling, specification writing, bottleneck analysis, and pre- and post-silicon validation — with experienced architects mentoring you as you build toward owning more of this yourself.

About you
We’re looking for someone with a strong foundational understanding of computer or processor architecture — built through coursework, personal projects, internships, placements, or research — who’s genuinely curious about performance and power trade-offs and eager to learn how to navigate them. You don’t need prior industry experience as a Processor Architect; what matters is real hands-on exposure to processor or accelerator design, through a final-year project, FPGA build, RISC-V implementation, internship, or research, plus a comfort working across disciplines and a track record of thriving in ambiguity and fast iteration.

Key Requirements

  • A degree (BEng, MEng, MSc or equivalent) in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

  • A solid foundational understanding of computer/processor architecture, including matrix- and vector-centric floating-point arithmetic and memory hierarchies, gained through study, projects, internships, or research.

  • Some exposure to RTL design concepts and how physical design constraints feed back into architectural choices — academic or internship-level experience is fine.

  • Any hands-on exposure to architectural performance modelling tools (gem5, SystemC, or custom cycle-accurate simulators), compiler/toolchain interactions, or AI acceleration/vector-matrix compute, through study or projects, is highly valued.

  • A clear communicator, comfortable working across architecture, modelling, implementation, verification, and software teams, who thrives in ambiguity and fast iteration.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

jobs.description:

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The role

We build the control chain that powers on, monitors, updates, and protects devices and racks across bare metal, RTOS, and embedded Linux. We also build the communication mechanisms that connect devices to each other and to the host. Security runs through all of it. A chain of trust from the hardware up to the rack management plane: the root of trust each controller boots from, the signed updates that reach the fleet safely, the identity that lets a device prove what it is, the authenticated channels the controllers and devices talk over, and the runtime protections that keep the host Linux kernel and the on-die firmware trustworthy long after boot. These are the layers that let operators rely on the hardware.

You’d be deeply involved in that security across the chain, making it real in software. You’ll work hand in hand with our architecture and hardware teams, bringing the software and system-level view: turning threat models into concrete mechanisms in bare metal, RTOS, and Linux, then designing, prototyping, and validating them. Some of the calls in this model are still open, and you’ll help shape them.

We want engineers who understand security from the inside out. You know how the root of trust, boot chain, key hierarchy, and secure interconnects actually work under the hood, not just how to switch them on. In this role, the security of your software solutions depends entirely on how well you understand the hardware beneath it. Some of the protections we rely on live in silicon, some in software, and part of the skill is knowing which belongs where. We’re looking for people who know both sides well enough to build the mechanisms that close whole classes of bugs by design.

We’re not heavy on levels here! Whether you’d call yourself senior, staff, principal, or lead, what matters is depth of security judgement, system-level experience, and working well with the engineers around you. If you’ve worked deep in the security of real systems and like to get your hands on the code and the systems around it, we’d like to hear from you.

What you’ll do:

  • Shape the security of the control chain (device, board, chassis, and rack controllers): threat models, trust boundaries, and a coherent secure-by-design approach across all platforms

  • Design and help build secure boot and the root of trust on each controller: verified/measured boot, signing and verification, anti-rollback, and locking down debug and privileged access in production

  • Secure the interconnects, between controllers and between devices and the host, with authentication, integrity, and additional protections where needed

  • Design and build the cryptographic mechanisms: key hierarchies, provisioning and storage, device identity, and remote attestation so the fleet can prove what it’s running

  • Make firmware updates safe end to end: signed images, rollback protection, staged rollout, and clean recovery, across every hop of the chain

  • Protect the running system, not just boot: harden the host Linux kernel and the on-die firmware

  • Work closely with hardware and the rest of the software team to build security into the product, running threat-model reviews, triaging vulnerabilities, and driving fixes to closure

What we’re looking for:

We expect you to know the fundamentals, and to have real, practical experience across several of these:

  • An adversarial mindset and sharp threat-modeling instincts: trust boundaries, assets, attacks, and honesty about residual risk

  • Hands-on experience with the core security primitives in software and in silicon: secure boot, root of trust, cryptography, and key management, including how they’re implemented and where they can fail

  • Secure protocol and channel design between components

  • Strong C and Rust, and the instinct for memory safety and defensive coding that low-level security work needs

  • Experience building, not just using, security mechanisms: a secure-boot chain, key hierarchy, or attestation flow you shaped

That’s the core. We get especially curious about your application when you also bring some of the following. Very few candidates tick every box here, and we don’t expect you to:

  • Attestation at boot and at runtime, and management-plane protocols (DICE, IETF RATS, SPDM, MCTP, PLDM; confidential-computing directions like TDISP)

  • Hardware building blocks and firmware/Linux hardening (HSM, TPM, secure element, Caliptra, secure debug; open firmware/boot projects, image minimisation)

  • Assurance and resistance (supply-chain security with SBOM and SLSA, fuzzing and testing, standards like NIST 800-series, Common Criteria, OCP incl. S.A.F.E., TCG/DMTF; physical and side-channel awareness)

  • AI/LLM-assisted security tooling, and RISC-V / GPU / ML-accelerator experience

What you’re signing up for:

This is a young company doing hard things, balanced across hardware and software. We’re building the software layer for a whole inference system as it takes shape, so you’ll often be securing systems ahead of the hardware: reasoning about a threat model against a specification first, then a simulator, then early boards. You’ll work with incomplete information and watch it get sharper with every iteration. That takes comfort with ambiguity and a bias for action. If that sounds daunting, this may not be the role. If it sounds like the fun part, we should talk.

Boundaries between areas are soft here. Security touches every layer, so you’ll work across bare metal, RTOS, and Linux, and alongside the architecture and hardware teams as much as the rest of the software team. That breadth is a good part of the job.

You’ll be there for first bring-up, the first secure boot that verifies, the first device that attests itself, the first clean end-to-end run. A piece of what you built will live in silicon and in every rack we ship.

We want a team that reflects the world it’s built for, and we welcome applicants from every background, including those whose path here hasn’t been a straight line. We care that you’re excited by this kind of work, that you bring security rigour, and that you make a team better.

jobs.title: Revenue Enablement Manager (m/f/d), Just-in-Time Enablement
jobs.description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!

About the role

Every month, something new reaches our field teams from Product, Product Marketing and Marketing: a new use case, a fresh sales narrative, a campaign, a product update. Too often it arrives as a Slack post or a long deck, and sellers never really pick it up.

As Revenue Enablement Manager, Just-in-Time Enablement, you own that last mile. You are the front door between the teams who create news and the teams who use it, and you make sure every launch reaches Sales, Customer Success and Partnerships across Europe at the right time, in a format they can use in their next conversation.

What you'll do:

  • Run the launch intake. Be the single entry point for PMM, Product, Marketing and others who want something to reach the field. Prioritize with clear criteria so sellers aren't overloaded.

  • Own the field release calendar. Keep one view of what's coming, when, and for whom, shared with creators and sales managers.

  • Turn launches into what sellers need. Shape each release into: what's new, who it's for, why customers care, how to talk about it, and how to handle the likely questions.

  • Coach the creators. Brief PMM, Product and Marketing on what the field needs and review their materials before they go out. When the input is raw (specs, messaging docs, long decks), write the enablement content yourself: short, clear and practical.

  • Deliver just in time. Pick the right format and moment: a 20-minute live session, a short recording, a one-pager, a talk track. Not so early it's forgotten, not so late it's useless.

  • Make it stick. Run practice sessions, give managers simple talking points, and check that sellers can explain the new thing in their own words.

  • Check it landed. Track attendance, usage in calls and deals, and rep feedback. Share what you learn with the creators so the next launch is better.

  • Keep one home for launch material. Everything findable in one place with an owner and a review date; retire what's outdated.

  • Hand over to curriculum. Work closely with your colleagues in the revenue enablement team, who fold a launch into the regular training once it is no longer new. Agree what moves over, when, and in what form, so nothing is built twice.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years in revenue enablement, product marketing, sales training or a similar role in B2B SaaS, ideally at a scaleup.

  • Experience rolling out launches, messaging or campaigns to sales teams, with examples you can share.

  • Ability to explain a product use case or sales narrative simply, and to spot what a seller really needs from it.

  • Strong stakeholder skills: you can say "not this month", ask for a 3-slide version of a 40-slide deck, and keep the relationship strong.

  • Well organized: you juggle several launches at once and hit dates.

  • Clear writing and confident live facilitation.

  • Hands-on with LMS, AI, video editing tools, a CRM and call recording tools, and a habit of using data to check adoption.

  • Fluent English and German.

Nice to have:

  • Background in product marketing or product management.

  • Experience with security, compliance or HR-related products.

  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as SPICED or MEDDICC.

How success looks like:

First 30 days: learn

  • Meet the leads in PMM, Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Learn how launches reach the field today and where they get lost.

  • Review the last 3-5 launches: what reached the field and what stuck.

  • Agree which upcoming launches come first and who owns what, intake process and readiness gates.

Days 31-60: set up and pilot

  • Start the launch intake and a first field release calendar.

  • Take 1-2 launches through the process, writing the enablement content from the raw input.

  • Agree with the Curriculum team how a launch moves into regular training once it's no longer new.

Days 61-90: prove and adjust

  • Run 2-3 launches end to end; sellers can explain each one in their own words within two weeks of release.

  • Collect feedback from reps, managers and creators, and fix what slowed things down.

  • Share first results with leadership (reach, use in real calls) and a plan for the next quarter.

Who you'll work with:

  • Reports to the Head of Revenue Enablement.

  • Product Marketing and Product, who own the narratives and use cases.

  • Marketing, who run campaigns that sellers need to follow up on.

  • Sales, Customer Success and Partnerships leaders and frontline managers, who receive and reinforce the message.

  • The Curriculum team in Revenue Enablement, who take over launch content for the long-term training programs.

  • Revenue Operations for tools and data.

What we offer*:

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer
jobs.description:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision

We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus!

What you will do

  • Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring. 

  • Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing.

  • Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar).

  • Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle.

  • Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously. 

  • Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation.

  • Support and mentor team members.

  • Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc.

  • Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team.


Your profile

  • 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field.

Skills

  • Ability to translate user needs and requirements into technical requirements and a development plan.

  • Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data.

  • Hands-on experience with MLOps practices for scalable training, deployment and monitoring.

  • Experience in developing and deploying ML models for a consumer product (mature development processes), ideally in the healthcare space or a regulated environment.

  • Ability to iterate quickly from ideas to experiments, learning from results and making data-driven decisions.

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from intricate datasets.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the capacity to effectively convey technical concepts to diverse audiences.

  • Proven ability to thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Experience with mentoring and leading team members.

What we offer you

  • A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy

  • A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam

  • An enthusiastic, professional, and international team

  • Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities

  • Unlimited skin checks for you

jobs.description:
À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA.

Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle, en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

En tant que Data Migration Project Manager, tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.

À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client, ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %), tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

Tes missions

Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z

  • Piloter plusieurs projets clients simultanément, du cadrage à la livraison, en priorisant efficacement pour garantir un suivi fluide et de qualité.

  • Piloter le suivi et l’avancement des projets à travers des meetings clients

  • Comprendre les enjeux métier et Privacy du client afin d’adapter la stratégie de migration à son contexte et à ses besoins.

  • Accompagner le client dans les choix techniques et data nécessaires à sa migration

  • Sécuriser chaque étape de la migration, de la préparation des données jusqu’à leur intégration dans Dastra

Comprendre & structurer la data

  • Analyser et structurer les données sources du client

  • Construire le mapping entre les données clients et le modèle de données Dastra

  • Définir et paramétrer les règles de transformation nécessaires à la migration

  • Contrôler les données tout au long du processus de migration

  • Comprendre la logique des scripts et des flux de données

  • Maîtriser notre outil interne de migration

Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisées via des scripts spécifiques : nous ne cherchons donc pas un développeur, mais quelqu'un qui comprend suffisamment la technique pour prendre les bonnes décisions.

Collaborer avec les équipes Dastra

Tu travailles notamment avec :

  • les Sales, en avant-vente, pour apporter l’expertise Data Migration nécessaire au cadrage du projet et rassurer les prospects

  • les équipes Tech, sur les problématiques d'intégration et de fonctionnement de la plateforme ; 

  • les Privacy Success Managers, pour assurer une transition fluide après la migration et transmettre les enjeux et règles métier du client. 

Le profil recherché

  • Environ 4 ans d'expérience en gestion de projets clients, idéalement autour de l'implémentation, la migration, l'intégration ou la transformation de données.

  • Une expérience indispensable en gestion multiprojet et multiclient, idéalement en cabinet de conseil, ESN ou environnement SaaS 

  • Une connaissance des enjeux RGPD / Privacy et du métier de DPO, acquise dans un contexte professionnel

  • Une bonne culture IT & data : mapping, structuration de données, logique de scripts, compréhension des flux et architectures 

  • Une capacité à prendre rapidement en main un nouvel outil et à comprendre son fonctionnement

  • À l'aise pour conseiller, challenger et vulgariser auprès d'interlocuteurs techniques et métier 

  • Anglais C2 indispensable 

Ce qui fera la différence

Tu es curieux·se, autonome et débrouillard·e : face à un nouvel outil ou une problématique que tu ne connais pas, tu cherches, tu comprends et tu proposes.

Tu apprécies autant comprendre comment fonctionne une plateforme que piloter un projet et accompagner un client jusqu'à sa réussite.

Tu as, à minima, une expérience auprès de DPO, équipes Privacy/Compliance ou sur un logiciel GRC/Privacy.

Pourquoi rejoindre Dastra ?

jobs.title: Business Development Intern
jobs.description:
Big changes start with people who want to achieve more.

How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice?

At Urban Connect, we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom.

Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility.

To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together.

Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility

Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen?

During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities.

Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work.

How you will make a difference

  • Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions.

  • Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts.

  • Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected.

  • Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes.

  • Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships.

  • Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions.

  • Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps.

  • Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team.

What you bring

  • An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject.

  • Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative.

  • An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply.

  • Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things.

  • Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us.

  • An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team.

  • Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus.

Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it.

What you can expect

High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow.
We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving.

A view of the whole business.
You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value.

Direct access and room to take initiative.
Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment.

The opportunity to build a future with us.
If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company.

You will also benefit from:

  • Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich.

  • A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars.

  • A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together!

Ready to make a difference?

Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself?

We look forward to meeting you.

functionHR ist ein Spin-Off der LMU München. Wir entwickeln eine innovative und preisgekrönte Softwarelösung für Mitarbeiterbefragungen und People Analytics. Damit begleiten wir Unternehmen auf ihrem Weg zum datengestützten Personalmanagement. Durch die Verbindung von Statistik, Machine Learning und künstlicher Intelligenz mit innovativen Web-Anwendungen revolutionieren wir die Art und Weise, wie HR-Entscheidungen in Unternehmen getroffen werden. Zu unseren Kunden zählen namhafte Unternehmen verschiedener Branchen und Größen.

Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir schnellstmöglich Verstärkung als

CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER (M/W/D) in Teilzeit/Vollzeit (mind. 32h/Woche)

Sorge gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden dafür, dass ihre Befragungsprojekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden, und begleite sie als kompetente Ansprechperson von der Implementierung bis zur langfristigen Nutzung unserer Plattform.

DAS SIND DEINE AUFGABEN:

Projektmanagement

  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden und baust langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen auf

  • Du unterstützt sowohl die Software-Einführung als auch Support-Prozesse im laufenden Betrieb

  • Du strukturierst und koordinierst Projekte, definierst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Meilensteine und behältst die fristgerechte Umsetzung im Blick.

  • Du hast neben dem Kundenerfolg auch die wirtschaftliche Perspektive im Blick, achtest auf den vereinbarten Leistungsumfang und erkennst frühzeitig Potenziale für zusätzliche Leistungen und Upselling.

Fachliche Betreuung

  • Du bist fachliche:r Sparringspartner:in für unsere Kunden rund um organisationspsychologische Themen und berätst sie rund um Fragebogenerstellung, Befragungsdesign und Datenprozesse.

  • Du konzipierst und moderierst Webinare, Workshops und Trainings und entwickelst unser Customer Enablement kontinuierlich weiter.

Anforderungsmanagement

  • Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen unserer Kunden und übersetzt diese in konkrete Anforderungen an unsere Software und Services.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Entscheidungen und nächste Schritte klar dokumentiert und nachvollziehbar sind.

  • Du testest Neuentwicklungen und kundenindividuelle Setups kritisch, stellst deren Qualität sicher und bringst Verbesserungspotenziale direkt ins Team ein.

SO ÜBERZEUGST DU UNS:

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und behältst auch in großen, komplexen Projekten den Überblick

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise in Arbeits- und Organisationspsychologie, Sozialforschung, Soziologie oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

  • Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung mit, idealerweise im B2B-Software- und HR-Tech Umfeld.

  • Du arbeitest analytisch, strukturiert und eigenständig.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher und überzeugend auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Idealerweise kennst du bereits den People-Analytics- oder Mitarbeiterbefragungsbereich oder hast Lust, dich schnell und tief in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.

DAS BIETEN WIR:

  • Erfahrenes, motiviertes und eingespieltes Team von Entwicklern und Data Scientists

  • Große Flexibilität bezüglich Arbeitszeiten und Arbeitsort – 100% Remote möglich (Dt. Wohnsitz nötig)

  • EGYM Wellpass mit geringem Eigenanteil

  • Spannende Einblicke in international tätige Unternehmen aller Größen und die Möglichkeit echte Wirkung auf Entscheidungsprozesse bei Kunden zu erzielen

  • Flache Hierarchien und viel Entscheidungsfreiheit

  • Modernes Toolset – GitLab, Figma & Co. für effiziente Zusammenarbeit

  • Moderne Hardwareausstattung

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events – auch remote bleiben wir connected

DAS SPRICHT DICH AN?

Wenn Du noch Fragen hast oder dich direkt bewerben möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Kontaktaufnahme. Bitte beachte, dass wir den Prozess ab 10.11.2026 starten werden.

jobs.title: Staff Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

This is a senior individual contributor role in our Data Services & Governance team where you'll act as the thought and technical leader owning the semantic layer and analytics standards for Pleo. This means that you won't own a domain but you'll own what good looks like across all of them by developing, improving , maintaining and evangelising our modelling standards and AI-augmented development practices that every Analytics Engineer work with, regardless of which team they sit in.

The semantic layer you will be designing and maintaining will be the single source of truth that AI agents, BI tools, and analysts query. This is foundational work with company-wide reach which will be ideal for you if you enjoy building things from the ground up. Our semantic layer is still in very early stage. Tooling selection is live, and this role has a strong voice in it. Our BI stack is also in transition so, you would not be inheriting a mature setup and maintaining it. You'd be deciding what it should be, then building it.

For additional context, our tech stack currently include: GCP, BigQuery, dbt Core, Airflow, SQL, Python, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot.

Who you'll work with

You'll report to the Data Engineering Manager who oversees the Data Infra & MLOps team as well as the Data Services & Governance team. Your primary relationship will be with Analytics Engineers embedded across the Intelligence function who should come to you for architecture guidance, semantic layer decisions, and standards questions. You will also partner with a Staff Data Engineer on data engineering standards and pipeline practices, and with others on self-serve analytics and BI tooling governance. You'll engage with the Data Serving team on entity definitions and with the GenAI Platform team on what AI-ready data looks like at the platform boundary.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the semantic layer: define what a metric definition is, how it's structured, where it lives, and how it's enforced. The goal is one canonical definition of Monthly recurring revenue (MRR), churn, transaction, customer - used by analysts, BI tools, and AI tools without divergence. You make that real, not aspirational.

  • Set data modelling standards for the function: what clean, layered, well-tested dbt architecture looks like across all domains, at all levels of complexity.

  • Build and run the Analytics Engineering community of practice including code reviews, shared patterns, documentation, onboarding etc. The goal is to create a social infrastructure that makes standards stick.

  • Own the AI-native development practice. Use AI coding tools as a native part of how you write, review, and migrate data models (not as a demonstration, but as your actual workflow). Evaluate what works in a governed data engineering context, what introduces risk, and shape how the Analytics Engineering community adopts it.

  • Lead responsible AI-augmented migration work using AI tooling to accelerate data modelling and migrations across the Analytics Warehouse and Operational Data Platform.

  • Design data models and metric definitions in a documented and structured manner enabling reliable consumption by AI services without human intervention.

  • Engage upstream with backend and product engineers to drive data contract discipline and schema ownership upstream, rather than managing inconsistency downstream.

  • Contribute to Data & AI Products for external customer-facing analytics where data modelling patterns and conversational analytics needs and capabilities grow.

What you bring

  • Deep demonstrated expertise in dbt and modelling practices: not just strong modelling, but a formed view of what modelling architecture should look like across a function. You can defend trade-offs, teach them, and enforce them in teams you don't manage.

  • Deep BigQuery and SQL expertise, including performance, cost considerations, and the architectural challenges of complex analytical domains.

  • Real experience owning a semantic layer (LookML, dbt MetricFlow, or equivalent). You have a point of view on what metric consistency should look like at scale, what breaks when it doesn't, and how to design it so AI tooling can consume it without degrading trust.

  • AI-native development practice in a data engineering context. You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a genuine part of how you work, and you can be specific about where they add real value and where they introduce risk in a governed analytics codebase.

  • A track record of setting standards across teams you don't directly manage and making them stick by leveraging effective influencing techniques as opposed to relying on authority.

  • Understanding of what LLMs and agentic tools need from a data layer such as how to model data, write documentation, and define metrics so that AI tools get consistent answers at runtime.

  • Proven experience engaging credibly with backend engineers on data contracts and with senior stakeholders on what the semantic layer strategy means for the business.

Why this role is a good fit for you

This role is a good fit if:

  • You can hold a standard without needing it applied perfectly, and you know which compromises are fatal and which are just untidy.

  • You genuinely enjoy growing a community of practice through influence rather than authority and you take pride in seeing colleagues adopt and grow standards.

  • You find the "how do we make data legible to an agent, not just to an analyst" problem interesting in its own right, rather than as a trend to keep up with.

This role is not a good fit if

  • You want to own a domain. The Intelligence teams have strong AEs doing that. This role is for someone who wants to own the standards they build to.

  • You advise others to use AI coding tools but don't use them yourself. AI-native development is part of the mandate, not a differentiating nice-to-have.

  • You are more comfortable being consulted than being accountable. The semantic layer and modelling standards you set have downstream consequences across the whole function and in AI features customers use.

Your first 6 months

By the end of your first six months, you'll have:

  • Mapped the current state of modelling standards and the semantic layer across the function (where definitions are consistent, where they diverge, and what the highest-impact gaps are) to draft a plan the function has bought into.

  • Contributed to the semantic layer tooling decision and begun onboarding the Analytics Engineers who'll build to it by writing documentation, running live sessions, reviewing PRs etc.

  • Established a visible presence in the AE community of practice and become someone whose feedback in code reviews and whose opinions on architecture are listened to because they've been demonstrated, not just stated.

  • Run your own workflow on AI coding tooling to the point where you can say clearly what the function should adopt, what it should not, and why.

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills test: A technical test you'll be taking through an external platform to showcase your grasp of analytics engineering fundamentals.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation-based interview aimed at deep diving into your previous experience and learning more about the team.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A live practical and technical interview designed to assess your problem solving skills as well as your technical expertise.

Alan exists to end the wait.

It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.

Über Cosuno

Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Volumen, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du bekommst jede Woche neue Kunden zugewiesen, die sich nicht selbst aktiviert haben, und führst sie durch das Onboarding: Erstkontakt innerhalb weniger Tage, Onboarding-Call per Screenshare, Profil und Suchprofil einrichten, erste Angebote begleiten. Rund 40 Onboardings im Monat, jedes etwa anderthalb Stunden Gesamtaufwand inklusive Vorbereitung und Nachfassen.

Du misst dich nicht am abgehaltenen Call, sondern am Kunden, der danach selbst weitermacht. Dafür verfolgst du die Aktivierungssignale jedes Kunden in Salesforce und greifst nach, wo einer hängen bleibt.

Du bist die Person im Unternehmen, die am häufigsten sieht, wo Neukunden scheitern. Dieses Wissen gibst du strukturiert an Product weiter, damit Tool Tips, Product Tours und Hilfetexte besser werden und mehr Kunden sich selbst aktivieren.

Du berichtest an den Head of Customer Success und arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team, das die Kunden abschließt, und mit den Customer Success Managern, die bei Kündigungen übernehmen.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Mindestens 90 % deiner Kunden sind 30 Tage nach dem Onboarding aktiv – Profil vollständig, Suchprofil eingerichtet, erstes Angebot abgegeben.

  • Jeder zugewiesene Kunde hat innerhalb von drei Werktagen von dir gehört.

  • Salesforce ist bei dir vollständig: Onboarding-Status, Aktivierungssignale, Hürden – bei jedem Kunden.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Wenn ein Kunde nach 30 Tagen nicht aktiv ist, fragst du zuerst, was du anders hättest machen können.

  • Speed. Du rufst heute an, nicht nächste Woche. Ein Kunde, der drei Wochen wartet, hat Cosuno vergessen.

  • Drive. Du hast schon einmal ein Skript, eine Checkliste oder einen Ablauf gebaut, weil der alte nicht funktioniert hat – ohne dass dich jemand gebeten hat.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du gern erklärst und dabei merkst, wann dein Gegenüber wirklich verstanden hat – und wann es nur nickt.

  • du 40 Gespräche im Monat als Rhythmus empfindest, nicht als Last.

  • du nach dem dritten Nichterreichen zum vierten Mal anrufst, zu einer anderen Uhrzeit – unsere Kunden stehen auf der Baustelle.

  • du Handwerksbetriebe magst und mit einem Dachdecker genauso sprichst wie mit einer Büroleitung.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Onboarding als Schulung verstehst und nach dem Call abhakst.

  • du Tickets abarbeiten willst statt Kunden hinterherzutelefonieren

  • du zehn Kunden intensiv betreuen möchtest statt vierzig in die Nutzung zu bringen.

  • dich eine Zahl über deinem Schreibtisch stresst statt motiviert.

Harte Anforderungen

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr in einer kundennahen Rolle mit Volumen: Onboarding, Customer Support mit Aktivierungsziel, Inside Sales, Kundenservice im B2B.

  • Sicher im Erklären von Software per Telefon und Screenshare.

  • Berlin oder Bereitschaft zu Bürotagen.

55.000 € OTE pro Jahr (Zielgehalt bei 100 % Zielerreichung), bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt und einer variablen Komponente, die sich nach deiner Zielerreichung richtet.

Was wir bieten

  • Klarheit: Eine Zahl, ein Playbook, direkter Einfluss auf dein Ergebnis – und auf das Produkt.

  • Entwicklung: Die Rolle ist der Einstieg in Customer Success bei Cosuno; der nächste Schritt ist Retention Sales oder Produkt-Enablement.

  • Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung.

  • Arbeitsort: Berlin-Kreuzberg oder hybrid, du wählst.

jobs.title: Organic Growth Manager (SEO & AI Search)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

Cosuno is the AI construction platform connecting the European construction industry. We're reconnecting one of Europe's largest and still largely analogue industries with AI: general contractors publish their tenders on Cosuno and find the right subcontractors, and subcontractors find the projects that fit them and win more of them. As our Organic Growth Manager, you make Cosuno the answer when contractors and trade firms search, on Google and in AI assistants: through our blog, our website and Marketplace pages, and the sources AI answers rely on. And you join just in time for our biggest marketing project of the year, the website relaunch with our agency, which you'll use to grow organic traffic significantly. You'll be one of the first to join the marketing lead in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how it operates as it scales, not just execute inside a fixed setup.

What you'll do

  • You build our blog into a steady source of qualified sign-ups: an editorial plan from search data, sales calls and trade press, original research from our platform data, and customer stories, written to a high German standard with freelance writers and AI tools.

  • You own website SEO: public Marketplace pages, landing pages and programmatic trade and region pages, plus technical health, structure and speed.

  • You make Cosuno the source AI assistants cite (GEO and AEO): answer-first pages, structured content and a tracked set of the prompts our customers ask.

  • You start our content partnerships: guest posts, joint studies and collaborations with trade media and partners that earn links and mentions. Until our Partnerships & Social Manager joins in mid-2027, you also keep organic LinkedIn and our founders' posts running, then hand them over.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organization. You'll set and execute the strategy for how we build revenue analytics across Salesforce and Looker, run insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business, partner closely with revenue leadership on the full range of topics they face, and, as you ramp up, take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

This is a generalist role by design: analytics is the foundation, especially in your first two quarters, and the role broadens from there to include business partnering and forecasting. What matters most is the versatility to move across all three, not depth in any single one.


What You'll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Build a highly automated revenue insights engine using AI, while establishing yourself as the business partner revenue leadership.

  • First 12 months: Broaden into leading and supporting the forecasting cadence.


What Will You Be Doing?

Revenue Analytics & Insights

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

  • Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider revenue leadership team rely on.

  • Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it.

  • Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep.

Business Partnership to Revenue leadership

  • Become the go-to Revenue Operations partner for revenue leadership, covering reporting, insights, and the broader range of topics that come up in running a sales organization.

  • Translate revenue leadership's open questions into structured analysis and clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Represent revenue's priorities into the Revenue Operations roadmap, and vice versa.

  • Support revenue leaders in business reviews, planning moments, and ad hoc requests with credible, fast turnaround.

Forecasting

  • Run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders alongside the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking.

  • Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion.

  • Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement.


What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level.

  • Exposure to Account Executive (AE) or similarly quota-carrying organization.

  • Strong Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data.

  • A genuine generalist mindset — as comfortable building a dashboard or an insights report, as running a forecasting call.

  • A track record of setting direction and quality bar for analytical work.

  • Strong stakeholder management, with the ability to work with and influence sales leadership and revenue executives.

  • Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end: framing the question, choosing the method, landing the recommendation.

  • Excellent written communication — the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role.

  • Experience partnering with global or multi-region teams is a plus.


What we Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan.   1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

⭐ Alan Precision: why this exists

Your body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them.

Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Belgian French speaking
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Join our sales team as an Account Executive to help us drive our Benelux & Nordics market! As an integral team member, you will report to the Sales Leader and work alongside motivated individuals passionate about changing how organisations manage their business travel and expenses.

We're looking for someone fearless in rolling up their sleeves, hitting the phones, and engaging with new customers to grow our client base. You should be hungry with an outbound mentality (you are expected to source a part of your pipeline yourself), perseverant, and focused, with excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills that enable you to win new clients and maintain strong relationships with existing ones.

But that's not all - we also value collaboration and teamwork, so you should be just as motivated to help your colleagues succeed as you are to meet your targets. We take pride in our fun, challenging, and inclusive culture and seek someone who shares our passion for creating a positive work environment. If you're excited about the prospect of selling a disruptive product that is changing the game for business travel management, we want to hear from you!

 

What will you be doing?

  • Prospecting your own pipeline and managing outbound and inbound leads for the Benelux & Nordics market, mainly focusing on the Belgian market;

  • Presenting demos to potential clients and owning the follow-up until closing the deal (Full sales cycle);

  • Seeking to understand the needs of your target prospects and articulating the value that Perk provides which is most aligned to the needs of that customer;

  • Conducting high-level discussions with various stakeholders, from Office Managers to CFOs;

  • Maintaining accurate information on prospects and interaction activities in Salesforce;

  • Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process;

  • Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features.

 

What we're looking for

  • Native French speaker;

  • Excellent communication and video presentation skills;

  • Experience working with the Benelux or Nordics markets;

  • Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives;

  • Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives;

  • Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle;

  • Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

  • Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team;

  • Customer-centric mindset;

  • You must have legal authorisation to work in Spain.

 

What we offer

  • 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

  • A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use.

  • Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 90 mins - Virtual

  • Final Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins IRL

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Grafische Vormgeving / DTP
jobs.description:
Over District 70

District 70 ontwikkelt stijlvolle, functionele en kwalitatieve producten voor huisdieren. Met oog voor design, gebruiksgemak en detail creëren we producten die niet alleen prettig zijn voor huisdieren, maar ook mooi passen in het interieur van hun baasjes.

Van productontwikkeling en verpakkingsdesign tot de uiteindelijke presentatie: vormgeving speelt bij District 70 een belangrijke rol. Om ervoor te zorgen dat onze producten en verpakkingen er tot in de kleinste details goed uitzien, zoeken we versterking voor ons creatieve team.

De functie

Ben jij een nauwkeurige en creatieve student met gevoel voor grafische vormgeving? Werk je graag met Adobe InDesign, Illustrator en Photoshop en heb je oog voor de kleinste details? Dan zoeken wij jou! Voor District 70 zijn we op zoek naar een enthousiaste werkstudent die ons parttime ondersteunt bij het aanpassen, opmaken en productieklaar maken van verpakkingsontwerpen en artworks.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze Visual Designer en houdt je bezig met uiteenlopende grafische en DTP-werkzaamheden. Van het verwerken van nieuwe teksten, logo's en productinformatie tot het aanpassen van bestaande verpakkingsdesigns en het voorbereiden van bestanden voor productie.

In deze functie draait het niet alleen om creativiteit, maar vooral ook om precisie. Je hebt oog voor de kleinste details, werkt gestructureerd en zorgt ervoor dat ieder artwork zowel visueel als technisch helemaal klopt.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Bestaande verpakkingsontwerpen aanpassen en opmaken in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator en Photoshop

  • Teksten, logo’s, iconen, barcodes en andere grafische elementen toevoegen, wijzigen of vervangen

  • Productinformatie en meertalige teksten nauwkeurig verwerken en controleren

  • Master carton- en inner carton-artworks (shipping marks) opmaken en aanpassen

  • De bestaande huisstijl en consistentie bewaken op het gebied van typografie, compositie, uitlijning en verhoudingen

  • Artworks drukwerk- en productieklaar maken, met aandacht voor kleurgebruik, afloop, resolutie en dielines

  • Correcties en feedback verwerken en bestanden zorgvuldig controleren voordat ze naar productie gaan

  • Bestanden, versies en correctierondes overzichtelijk beheren en archiveren

  • Fouten, afwijkingen en ontbrekende informatie zelfstandig signaleren en bespreken

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je volgt een mbo – of hbo – opleiding in de richting van Grafisch Vormgeven, Mediavormgeving, Graphic Design, DTP, Communicatie & Multimedia Design of vergelijkbaar

  • Goede kennis van Adobe InDesign, Illustrator en Photoshop

  • Je hebt kennis van of affiniteit met DTP, verpakkingsdesign en drukwerkvoorbereiding

  • Je bent bekend met technische begrippen zoals CMYK, Pantone, afloop, resolutie, vectorbestanden, dielines en drukklare PDF's

  • Je hebt een goed gevoel voor typografie, compositie en visuele consistentie

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een afwisselende parttimefunctie van 8 tot 16 uur per week

  • Een passend salaris afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Flexibele werktijden, goed te combineren met je studie

  • Mogelijkheid om praktijkervaring op te doen met verpakkingsdesign, DTP en artworkproductie

  • Ruimte om je grafische en technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan de uitstraling van een designgericht huisdierenmerk
