jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
About GeneralMind

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer who treats LLMs as production software, not as magic. Someone who can own the agent layer of our platform end to end - from prompt and context design, through tool use and orchestration, to evals, reliability, and continuous improvement in live customer environments.

This role sits at the intersection of two things that are rarely mastered together: shipping LLM-powered systems that actually work in messy enterprise reality, and the discipline of a real engineer - evals, observability, cost, latency, failure modes. Models get smarter every month. What stays scarce is the engineering judgment to make them reliably useful on top of SAP, Oracle, and the mess of real operational data.

You will be a senior individual contributor working directly with the founders. The person in this role won’t be handed a roadmap - they’ll help define it, and build the AI practice around it.

What you will do

AI Ownership

  • Own the agent layer end-to-end: prompt and context design, tool use, orchestration, evals, and long-term technical direction.

  • Be the person who understands why an agent made the decision it made - and who other engineers come to when a model behaves in ways they can’t explain.

  • Set the bar on how we build with LLMs: eval-driven development, context engineering, structured outputs, cost and latency discipline.

  • Make foundational decisions with conviction - which model, which pattern, which guardrail - document the reasoning, and evolve them as the system grows.

LLM Systems in Production

  • Design agents that survive real enterprise environments: ambiguous inputs, flaky upstream systems, exception cases that weren’t in anyone’s spec.

  • Build the eval harness that lets us ship confidently: offline evals, online evals, regression suites, human-in-the-loop review.

  • Think in failure modes: hallucinations, silent drift, prompt injection, tool misuse. Build the detection before you need it.

  • Own cost and latency as first-class product requirements, not afterthoughts.

Agent & Context Engineering

  • Design agent architectures that compose cleanly: tool selection, state, memory, planning, escalation.

  • Build the context layer that makes agents actually useful on top of SAP and Oracle data - retrieval, grounding, schema awareness, auditability.

  • Evolve agents without breaking live customer deployments; manage prompt and model versioning with intention.

  • Know when the right answer is a bigger model, a better prompt, a fine-tune, a tool, or just classical code.

Reliability & Systems Thinking

  • Detect regressions in agent behavior before a customer does; build the evals and observability to catch them early.

  • Own the operational posture of the AI systems you ship: alerting, runbooks, replay, on-call readiness.

  • Identify structural debt in prompts, pipelines, and context before it compounds; refactor with thought.

What we are looking for

  • Experience: 6+ years building production software, with clear ownership of LLM-powered systems in real customer environments - not demos, not notebooks.

  • LLM depth: Non-negotiable. You’ve shipped agents or LLM features that run on live traffic. You have strong opinions about prompting, context, tool use, structured outputs, and what breaks in production.

  • Evals as a first instinct: You don’t ship LLM code without a way to measure it. You’ve built eval pipelines that actually catch regressions, not just vibes.

  • Python depth: You’re fluent in Python and comfortable in production service codebases. You make deliberate calls about async, framework choice, and performance.

  • Reliability instinct: Hallucination containment, idempotency on tool calls, graceful degradation when a model is wrong - part of how you design, not patched in later.

  • End-to-end ownership: You’re comfortable being the person who holds the full agent picture - from prompt to production incident. You identify what’s broken or missing before you’re asked.

  • A real spike: We’re a strong team with broad coverage. What we’re hiring for is someone who brings a 10x improvement in an area we’re currently underinvested in. That might be agent evaluation, context engineering on enterprise data, agentic reliability, deep NLP/LLM internals, or domain-specific grounding. We don’t know exactly what shape it takes - but you should know what yours is, and be able to articulate why it matters.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About Evervault

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Senior/Staff Product Engineer for our Cards team in London. You’ll own problems end-to-end across our payments infrastructure: tokenisation, card network integrations, 3DS and dispute management. That runs from customer conversations, through API design, to production code and measuring whether it worked. You’ll lead by example: mentoring, raising the bar and owning technical direction, staying hands-on the whole time.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building core payments infrastructure, including tokenisation, network integrations, 3DS and dispute management

  • Designing developer-facing APIs, SDKs and primitives that developers enjoy using

  • Building high-throughput, distributed systems that handle millions of card transactions

  • Working directly with customers to understand their payment stacks, debug integrations and shape the roadmap

  • Shipping across the stack: backend services, APIs, UI components and documentation

  • Setting technical direction and mentoring engineers on the team

Requirements

  • 6+ years of engineering experience, including 2–4+ recent years in at least one of: payments infrastructure or fintech, developer tooling, or design-first products

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, networking and infrastructure, beyond just frameworks

  • Product-minded: you think about the developer experience of every API you design and judge your work by its impact on users

  • Comfortable explaining complex technical decisions to non-technical people and working in front of customers

  • Founder-like ownership: you take problems to completion without waiting to be told what to do

Nice to Have

  • Rust and TypeScript experience (we care more about engineering ability than our exact stack)

  • Knowledge of card payments: networks, tokenisation, 3DS or PCI DSS

This Might Not Be for You If…

  • You want to build from a spec: you’ll be expected to find and define the problem yourself

  • You want to manage people soon: this is primarily a Senior IC role with technical leadership rather than people leadership

  • You prefer to stay in one layer of the stack: you’ll move between backend, APIs, UI and docs

  • You’d rather avoid customers: you’ll be on calls and debugging integrations with them

  • You want to work fully remotely: we’re in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday

Compensation, Benefits & Why Join

  • Competitive, London weighted salary

  • Stock options with an extended exercise window

  • Private health insurance

  • Unlimited PTO and flexible working hours

  • Daily lunch budget

  • Senior technical influence on a small, fast-growing team building infrastructure that processes millions of card transactions

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter screen

  2. Hiring manager screen

  3. Technical interview

  4. Pair programming

  5. Systems design (for Staff-level candidates)

  6. Final round with our founder

  7. References and offer

Location

This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas.

Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response.

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

Join our Enterprise Sales team to drive new business growth across Spectre and Street.co.uk. With the support of our industry-leading, multi-award-winning prospecting and CRM technology, you’ll have the opportunity to drive new business, close high-value deals, and play a key role in shaping the future of PropTech in the UK.


As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Account Executive to spearhead enterprise-level sales, working closely with our VP of Sales to drive revenue growth. You’ll be responsible for prospecting, engaging, and closing high-value deals, selling to board-level stakeholders and securing strategic partnerships. This role requires a consultative sales approach, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to multi-thread across complex organisations to drive adoption of our full product suite.


If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in!


A bit about you…

  • You have 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record in enterprise sales.

  • Enterprise sales strategy expertise, including account mapping, multi-threading, and engaging multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong outbound prospecting skills, with experience in either Challenger, Gap Selling or PClub sales methodology, MEDDIC qualification methodology, forecasting, and ABM/ABS strategies.

  • Exceptional negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decision-makers and close high-value deals.

  • Consultative sales approach, able to understand business challenges and position tailored solutions.

  • Resilience, confidence, and presence - you can hold the room, drive conversations, and articulate value effectively.

  • A team player mindset, working collaboratively across departments to drive success.

  • Coachability, always seeking to refine your approach and stay ahead in enterprise sales best practices.

 


Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Senior Enterprise Account Executive at Street Group

  • Executing ABM/ABS strategies, identifying and targeting key accounts with a structured approach.

  • Prospecting and outbound outreach, using cold calling, email, and LinkedIn to generate new business opportunities.

  • Managing and optimising CRM data, ensuring accurate tracking of leads, interactions, and progress.

  • Conducting research on industries, prospects, and competitors to craft personalised outreach.

  • Handling objections with confidence, positioning value-driven solutions tailored to client needs.

  • Collaborating with our Technical Pre-Sales team to map prospect workflows and demonstrate how Street transforms the way their agency operates end to end.

  • Developing strong relationships with multiple stakeholders within a business to drive engagement.

  • Becoming a product expert, understanding how our solutions solve industry challenges.

  • Refining sales processes and methodologies, working closely with leadership to enhance effectiveness.

  • Collaborating with sales, marketing, and a Strategic SDR to ensure seamless lead handoff, targeted outreach, and effective nurture strategies.

  • Continuously improving performance, embracing feedback, and adapting to new strategies and insights.


You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • You've only ever done inside sales. This role is field-based, and roughly half your time is out with customers.

  • You need a fully qualified pipeline handed to you. Prospecting and pipeline generation are core to the role.

  • You're expecting a job where you can coast on existing relationships. We're hunting for new business into accounts we don't yet own.

  • You're looking for a fully remote role. We need you in the Manchester office a minimum of three days per week, every other week, and out with customers the rest of the time.

  • You think your product knowledge matters more than your ability to sell. We'll teach you the product; your commercial acumen is what we're hiring.

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!


Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

Back in 2015, our co-Founder, Tom Staff, spent his evenings building Spectre v1.0. He’d seen first-hand an opportunity to automate the very manual process of winning new business for estate agents. Spectre is now our multi award-winning, instruction generation tool, generating an average return on investment for them of over 3000%!

🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🕒 Flexible working hours
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🚂 Public transport season ticket loans

🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!


Salary

Basic £70k with an estimated OTE of £140,000. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do

Let's get the tricky part out of the way: this role doesn't fit neatly into a box. It's part legal tech specialist, part product expert, part solutions architect, and part trusted advisor. If you want a role that stays static, this isn't it.

Your mission is to help some of the world's leading law firms get the absolute most out of Legora. You'll understand how lawyers work, how firms operate, and where AI can make the biggest difference — then turn that potential into workflows that deliver real value.

You'll be the person clients call when they want to rethink how legal work gets done — whether that's transforming how a practice group delivers work, embedding Legora across an international firm, or helping partners build the case for AI adoption.

Specifically, you will

  • Act as a genuine thought partner to law firms — understanding their practice areas, commercial priorities and ways of working, then identifying high-value opportunities to transform how legal services are delivered.

  • Own the journey alongside Customer Success from early pilots through onboarding to firm-wide adoption, turning initial use cases into sustained, measurable impact across teams, offices and practice groups.

  • Design and implement workflows around the realities of private practice — from due diligence, contract review and drafting to litigation, regulatory advisory, transactions and knowledge management.

  • Partner with law firm partners, innovation leaders, knowledge teams and practising lawyers to build the case for AI adoption, connecting Legora's capabilities to outcomes that matter to the firm and its clients.

  • Be the voice of the private practice lawyer inside Legora — bringing a deep understanding of legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial realities of law firms into product development, roadmap priorities and strategic direction.

  • Deliver clear, confident product demos, workshops and training that make the potential of Legora tangible for everyone from associates and partners to firm leadership.

  • Help firms navigate one of the most significant shifts in legal service delivery — moving beyond individual productivity gains towards fundamental changes in how legal work is performed, priced and delivered to clients.

  • Document what works, build scalable playbooks and help shape how Legora partners with leading law firms as we grow globally.

What you'll bring

You've worked in private practice and understand the reality of delivering legal advice in a law firm. You know that great legal work isn't just about getting the right answer — it's about delivering exceptional quality under pressure, managing demanding clients, exercising sound judgement and balancing commercial expectations with the highest professional standards.

But you've also never been entirely satisfied with how legal work has always been done. You're curious about technology, drawn to better ways of working, and excited by the opportunity to fundamentally change how law firms operate and deliver value to their clients.

We're looking for

  • Meaningful experience working within a law firm, giving you a strong understanding of private practice, legal workflows, client expectations and the commercial pressures of delivering legal services.

  • Strong legal judgement and credibility. A legal qualification is valuable, but we're ultimately interested in your ability to understand sophisticated legal work and how it can be transformed.

  • Tech-curious and product-savvy — not necessarily a coder, but someone who leans into technical conversations around generative AI, implementation and workflow transformation.

  • Commercially minded — you understand how law firms operate and can connect changes in legal workflows to outcomes that matter to partners, practice groups and their clients.

  • A natural translator — comfortable moving between practising lawyers, partners, innovation and knowledge teams, product teams and engineers.

  • Someone who brings structure to ambiguity and energy to complexity — the calm, credible presence clients rely on when they're navigating significant change.

  • Proactive and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple complex client relationships without losing quality or pace.

  • High standards without perfectionism — you ship, you learn, and you make it better over time.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Summary

Strategic Partnership Manager · London, UK

Andela is hiring a London-based Strategic Partnership Manager to own and grow our co-sell partnership with GitHub, one of our most strategic technology partners, across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. GitHub is one of our highest-priority partnerships, and EMEA is where our co-sell momentum with them is strongest.

partner-influenced revenue it produces. That means building trust with GitHub's field sellers and partner team, running deal registration and co-sell, mapping accounts, and keeping our program standing current so the partner sends us more opportunities and continues to invest in us.

GitHub is the anchor, but the role is built to flex. You will work across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem, including co-sell, consumption credit and partner funding programs. As activity grows in region, you will extend the same motion to our AI lab partners. Exceptional Leadership:

As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.

  • Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.

Key Responsibilities

Own the GitHub partnership in EMEA

  • Build and maintain relationships with GitHub's EMEA field sellers, partner managers, solution engineers and services leaders, so Andela is the partner they bring into accounts first.

  • Own the joint Partner Business Plan for the region, and run the QBR cadence and monthly deal reviews with GitHub.

  • Represent Andela in person at partner offices, sales kickoffs, field events and executive meetings across EMEA.

Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue

  • Source new opportunities from the partner's field organization and qualify them before bringing in Andela sales and Solutions Managers.

  • Run co-sell on live deals: connect partner sellers with Andela sellers, keep the partner informed through close, and remove blockers on both sides.

  • Map accounts with GitHub to agree on which customers we target together, then align Andela's EMEA sales team on how to pursue them.

  • Build and manage partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, with clean attribution in Salesforce.

Run deal registration, funding and program mechanics

  • Register every partner-involved opportunity so Andela receives credit for the consumption and seats we drive (for example, platform seats and cloud consumption).

  • Identify and secure deal-based partner funding, including co-investment and incentive programs, so sellers have more pricing flexibility on competitive deals.

  • Manage marketplace listings and partner program tiers: track designation and specialization requirements, certification counts, customer references and registered-deal thresholds, and file what is needed to maintain or move up a tier.

  • Maintain partner attribution tooling, such as partner portals and deal and consumption tagging.

Work across the Andela partner team

  • Bring Solutions Managers into qualified opportunities and partner enablement sessions, and relay what partner sellers need back into our offers.

  • Partner with the Partner Marketer on campaigns to partner sellers, joint customer campaigns and events, and own follow-up with partner sellers on the leads they produce.

  • Feed wins back into customer stories and references that strengthen our standing with each partner.

  • Report on partner pipeline, bookings, funding secured and program status to the Director of Partnerships and sales leadership.

Extend the motion to more partners

  • Apply the same co-sell playbook across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem in EMEA.

  • As activity grows, support our AI lab partners in region: partner seller relationships, deal registration, program tiers and marketplace presence.

How success is measured

  • Partner-sourced bookings (primary), with partner-influenced bookings credited at a lower weight.

  • Deals registered and accepted by the partner, and co-sell opportunities with a partner seller engaged.

  • Partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, and co-sell wins.

  • Partner funding secured, and partner consumption driven (platform seats, cloud consumption, AI licenses).

  • Program status: designations achieved, tier requirements met, business plans current and QBRs held on schedule.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in partner, alliance or channel management at a technology services firm, consultancy, systems integrator or ISV.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with the GitHub partner program or a comparable cloud or developer-platform partner program: co-sell, deal registration, partner portals and partner funding claims.

  • A track record of carrying a partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue target and growing pipeline through a partner's field sellers.

  • Experience running joint business plans, QBRs and account mapping with a large technology partner.

  • Enough technical fluency in software development, DevOps, platform migration or AI adoption to qualify an opportunity before bringing in a solutions specialist.

  • Comfortable working through others: you influence partner sellers and internal sales teams without direct authority.

  • Strong organization and follow-through on program mechanics, with clean CRM hygiene (Salesforce preferred).

  • Based in or able to work from London, and able to travel across EMEA for partner meetings and events.

Preferred

  • Exposure to AI lab partner programs, or interest in growing into them. We value candidates with a strong GitHub or cloud partner foundation who can carry that motion into newer programs.

You will work across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, owning campaigns from setup through to optimisation, and working closely with colleagues across Marketing, Data Science, Marketing Technology and more.   • Develop, launch and scale paid search campaigns across EU markets, optimising for performance and growth

  • Deliver an always-on testing programme across ads, landing pages and other areas, and contribute to our test and learn roadmap

  • Explore and apply AI tools and automation to improve how we build, optimise and analyse campaigns

  • Analyse campaign performance and test results, turning them into clear insights and practical recommendations

  • Take ownership of your work with a high degree of autonomy, managing several priorities at once with care and attention to detail

  • Work with large data sets to spot trends, solve problems and uncover opportunities to grow our market share

  • Collaborate with colleagues across the business to share learnings, including what works well and what doesn’t, and play an important part in the success of our European growth strategy

We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Fluency in English and strong communication skills, with the ability to explain data-led recommendations clearly

  • A solid understanding of digital marketing tactics, particularly how the Google auction works and automated bidding

  • Ideally, experience with feed-based tools, AI-powered campaign types, or other PPC management platforms

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead one of our product engineering squads, reporting to an engineering director. As Seccl grows and our platform supports more customer firms and investors, you’ll help your squad deliver the scalable platform capability we need for what comes next.

You’ll build a strong, psychologically safe engineering team where people feel trusted, supported and able to do their best work. You’ll coach and develop engineers, create clarity and help the team maintain high standards while delivering valuable outcomes.

Working closely with your product manager, engineering leaders and teams across Seccl, you’ll help define priorities and keep the squad focused on the right outcomes. You’ll balance delivery pace with engineering quality, security, operational resilience and long-term maintainability.

This role brings together people leadership, delivery and engineering accountability. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to guide and challenge decisions, while giving engineers the ownership and support they need to develop effective solutions.

What you’ll own

  • Building, leading and developing an inclusive, high-performing engineering squad

  • Creating an environment of trust, psychological safety, continual learning and constructive challenge

  • Owning the delivery health of your squad, from priorities and planning through to production readiness, reliability and ongoing maintainability

  • Partnering with product managers to align the squad’s work with customer, commercial, regulatory and platform priorities

  • Guiding technical decisions and helping the team build solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient and well integrated with the wider platform

  • Using metrics, feedback and team insight to improve delivery predictability, system reliability and team effectiveness

  • Recruiting and onboarding engineers while contributing to shared engineering practices and collaboration across Seccl

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re an experienced engineering manager who has led teams working within complex product or technology domains

  • You have a strong track record of hiring, onboarding, coaching and developing engineers

  • You can balance people leadership with delivery accountability and remain close enough to the technology to offer meaningful guidance

  • You have experience with a modern JavaScript and cloud-based technology stack. Our stack includes Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, MongoDB, AWS, Lambda and Serverless Framework

  • You communicate clearly and can work effectively with product managers, engineering leaders and senior stakeholders

  • You have recent, practical experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and can help teams use them responsibly to improve delivery, quality and developer effectiveness

  • You care about building secure, scalable and resilient systems. Experience in financial services, fintech, investment platforms or another regulated environment would be valuable

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re looking for a purely people-management role. You’ll need enough technical credibility to guide decisions and challenge constructively

  • You want to be the primary technical decision-maker. You’ll create the environment for engineers to own solutions and grow their capability

  • You need priorities to remain fixed. You’ll be leading delivery in a fast-moving environment where plans and business needs can change

  • You prioritise speed at the expense of quality. Delivery pace matters, alongside security, resilience and long-term maintainability

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 £95,000 to £110,000 depending on experience, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

You'll take ownership of Agile delivery effectiveness across one or more defence software Squads, working at the intersection of Product, Engineering and business stakeholders to turn complex priorities into predictable, sustainable delivery.

This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), where Senior Scrum Masters contribute not only to team success, but also to the continuous improvement of delivery practices across the wider organisation.

You'll operate in a multi-Squad environment with dependencies spanning engineering, product, documentation and customer-facing teams. The role extends beyond a single Squad and requires the ability to influence outcomes across organisational boundaries.

Your Squads deliver valuable outcomes predictably and sustainably, while collaboration across teams continues to improve. Product, Engineering and business stakeholders understand priorities, risks and dependencies early enough to act on them rather than react to them.

Teams take ownership of their commitments and continuously improve how they work, using Agile practices as tools for delivery rather than goals in themselves.

Piloter la communication autour de la migration

  • Identification des clients à contacter et segmentation des populations ;

  • Organisation des relances et suivi des réponses ;

  • Gestion des objections, questions et éventuels points de blocage ;

  • Formalisation des bonnes pratiques et des argumentaires.

Prioriser les migrations

Tu contribueras à définir une stratégie de priorisation des clients en fonction de différents critères :

  • Niveau d’engagement et de réponse des interlocuteurs ;

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🔥 Our Business Operations team

At Joko, the Business Operations team is the powerhouse behind internal innovation. We tackle the company’s most strategic and complex challenges and we don’t just solve them, we turn them into long-term, scalable growth engines. Whether it's launching entirely new business lines, rethinking revenue infrastructure, or embedding AI into our operations, we lead high-impact initiatives that push Joko forward faster, smarter, and stronger.

Our mission: Help Joko operate at its absolute best, every single day.

🦾 The role in one sentence

Security is Joko’s number one priority, and you will own it where it touches every employee: from every laptop to every identity and tool. You turn the initiatives already underway into a secure-by-design, automated foundation, so a fast-growing, AI-driven company can move fast, safely.

🎯 Context

Joko is the AI shopping app that helps millions of people save time and money: 7 million users, 10,000 merchants and a team of ~120 people from 18 nationalities, heading to 200+ by the end of 2027. Enterprise-grade security (SSO, MFA, audits) is one of our six company-wide priorities for 2026, and our internal IT foundation needs to scale with us: identity management, device management, business tooling, and endpoint security. This is a rare chance to own that foundation at a pivotal moment, with a blank canvas to build on and a company-wide priority behind you. This role sits at the intersection of IT Ops and security — a cross-functional role that touches everyone in the company.

🚀 Your missions

1. IT foundation & identities

  • Set up an Identity Provider (company-wide SSO, plus SCIM for access lifecycle management), and own the password manager while ensuring MFA is activated wherever possible.

  • Make access zero-touch: our goal is to connect most of our tools to the Identity Provider so access is granted and removed automatically. You build the integrations and automations (SSO, SCIM, low-code workflows) that make it happen.

  • Deploy an MDM solution for centralised device management (device fleet, configuration, compliance).

  • Review our company tooling catalogue: make sure everyone has the minimum access they need, and that security audits are up to date.

2. Security of the working environment

  • Drive security best practices for the working environment (endpoint hardening, access management, ongoing team awareness such as training and phishing simulations).

  • Be the go-to owner of the security of our employees' working environment.

  • Security review of new tools: run the security audit on every new tool, including AI tools, and on any new way of using the tools we already have, before it is rolled out.

  • Own the AI security policy: define, maintain and promote Joko’s AI security policy.

3. Day-to-day run

  • Access management: With tool owners, manage access across our stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Keeper, AI tools, business SaaS): permissions, roles, reviews, onboarding, offboarding and external users. Your mission: automate today’s largely manual processes and make them as efficient as possible.

  • Security alert & incident management: monitor, triage and handle alerts from our identity, device and endpoint security tools, and act as first responder on incidents affecting the working environment (compromised account, lost device, phishing, malware alert). Build and maintain incident response playbooks, and run post-incident reviews so we keep improving.

  • Fleet management: In collaboration with the people team, device onboarding and offboarding.

  • First-line employee support: helping colleagues with technical questions related to our tools.

💚 Why you'll love this role

  • Build, don't just maintain: you choose, deploy and shape the IdP, MDM and EDR stack from day one.

  • Real ownership and visibility: your work is felt by every employee, every day, and directly supports one of the company's top priorities.

  • A pioneering topic: help define how we safely adopt AI agents and AI-powered workflows, in a company where everyone uses AI daily.

  • A company on the rise: 7M users, 10k merchants, and a team growing from ~120 to 200+ — with a strong international, partly remote culture.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • A builder at heart: you automate everything you can, and you’d rather build a tool or workflow than repeat a manual task. Showing you’ve built and automated things matters as much as your previous experience in IT & Security.

  • Solid IT fundamentals (identities, device management, endpoint security, enterprise SaaS tooling), gained over ~4-7 years in IT Ops, security or systems administration.

  • Strong cross-functional communication: able to gather context from business teams and translate security stakes into plain language.

  • Rigor, autonomy, and a taste for building clear, durable processes.

  • Open and eager to learn on emerging topics — notably AI agents and their security — and excited to help build this area from the ground up.

✨ What would make the difference (nice to have)

  • Experience with an enterprise EDR / anti-malware.

  • Awareness of security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001…).

  • Hands-on experience deploying an IdP (Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID…) and/or an MDM (Jamf, Kandji, Intune…).

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A, Finance Operations, and Procurement, each with its own ressources. Today, the team consists of 2 people but are actively recruiting toward a target organization of 7. Most of it is still to be hired and built — by you. You will report to Quentin, our COO.

✨ Why this role is special

  • You build the function instead of inheriting it. The target organization — FP&A, Finance Operations, Procurement — exists on paper and almost nothing of it is built. You recruit the team, set the standards, and decide how Finance operates for the next stage of the company. The role is designed to grow into VP Finance once the function is in place.

  • You get a genuinely 360 scope. Planning, accounting close, cash, financing, multi-entity structuring, procurement, and investor relations all sit with you — across multiple business lines, in France, Spain, and the US, with more markets coming. Very few finance leaders get that full surface at this stage.

  • You join a profitable company that is moving fast. Joko is already profitable and keeps growing quickly, with new business lines and countries opening. You build a finance function for a company on the offensive, not one managing a slowdown.

  • You sit at the table where the decisions are made. You partner directly with the COO and the co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, and business line priorities, with the numbers you built as the basis of the discussion.

🎯 What you will do

This is a builder role. We are looking for a finance leader who runs the core of Finance hands-on today and builds the team that will run it tomorrow. Over the next two years, your mandate is to recruit the people the function is missing, set up the three poles, and put in place the processes that let you step back from the day-to-day.

We prefer to say it upfront: if what excites you is leading a team that already exists, this is not the role. If you want to build one on solid foundations and grow with it, it is a great one.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own planning and reporting: budget, forecast, and actuals vs. budget across all business lines (Online, Card-Linked, Gift Cards) and geographies.   • Run the accounting close and controls: monthly and annual closing with our external accountants across France, Spain, and the US, the audit of our financial statements, and robust controls to prevent fraud and errors. Build toward group consolidation under international standards (IFRS) as entities are added;

  • Manage cash and financing: day-to-day cash visibility, Gift Cards working capital, multi-currency flows, and our relationships with banks and financing partners. Cash is king — make sure the whole company knows it;

  • Structure a multi-entity group: how our entities are organized, intercompany flows, transfer pricing, cost allocation, and local compliance as we open new countries;

  • Be the financial voice at the leadership table: partner with the COO and co-founders on market expansion, investment allocation, pricing, and business line priorities;

  • Support investor relations: investor model, financial reporting, and fundraising preparation;

  • Drive cost efficiency: work with budget owners on their targets and negotiate key supplier contracts;

  • Do the work, with AI: you will be a high-level individual contributor as much as a manager. We expect you to use AI to automate repetitive work (reporting, reconciliation, data extraction) and augment analysis, so a lean team operates like a much larger one;

  • Coordinate with external partners: accountants, auditors, and financial advisors.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 10+ years of experience combining traditional finance (audit, transaction services, corporate finance, investment banking, or private equity) and finance in a high-growth tech company or scale-up. Ideally, you have done several cycles in companies at a stage close to ours.

  • Breadth: You have worked hands-on on at least two of the three pillars of a finance function: FP&A and business projection, accounting / financial control / cash, and financing / structuring / procurement. You are a 360 finance profile, not a specialist of one area.

  • Ownership: You have run a finance function, or a large part of one, end to end, and you have led or coordinated a team. You are ready to build a bigger one.

  • Team builder: You have hired and developed finance people yourself, and you know what good looks like when you interview for FP&A, accounting, or procurement profiles.

  • AI-native mindset: You use AI tools in your work today and have a practical point of view on how they change the finance function.

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

About the role

You’ll run Morpho’s corporate IT: accounts and access, laptops, and the SaaS tools the company runs on, all set up securely. You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. We’d rather automate repetitive work than hire for it, so expect to write scripts and build your own tooling, using AI where it helps. We’ll go through our stack with you early in the process.

Responsibilities

  • Administer SSO, the directory and the password manager. Handle onboarding and offboarding, and run regular access reviews.

  • Manage the Mac fleet: setup, MDM policies, OS and app updates, and keeping the endpoint security agent installed and working.

  • Apply the security baselines and access policies the security team defines, and keep our tools configured to match.

  • Administer our SaaS tools: setup, admin access and licences. Handle the IT side of bringing on new vendors.

  • Support the security team during incidents by isolating devices, revoking access and pulling logs.

  • Provide evidence for IT controls during audits.

  • Automate repetitive work such as onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and evidence collection.

  • Write and maintain documentation for IT procedures.

  • Take part in IT on-call.

Definition of success

  • 1 month: handles onboarding, offboarding and day-to-day account and device work without help, and knows how our tools are set up.

  • End of probation: owns our identity, device and SaaS setup, has automated at least one process that used to be manual, and is the person the security team goes to for IT changes and incident support.

  • 12 months: runs corporate IT independently. Onboarding, offboarding, access reviews and audit evidence mostly run on tooling they built.

Experience

  • 5+ years in IT, systems engineering or IT security.

  • Hands-on admin experience with an enterprise identity provider, an MDM and endpoint security tools.

  • Strong macOS management: configuration profiles, privacy preference and system extension policies.

  • Writes Python or Bash to automate work. Infrastructure as code is a plus.

  • Has supported a SOC 2, ISO 27001 or similar audit.

  • Knows crypto companies are frequent targets of phishing and social engineering, and sets up systems with that in mind. Web3 or fintech experience is a plus.

  • Writes clear documentation.

  • Prefers simple setups people follow over perfect ones they work around.

  • Comfortable being part of an on-call rotation.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

jobs.title: Senior contractmanager (domein IT)
jobs.description:
Wil jij ervoor zorgen dat belangrijke contracten niet alleen goed zijn afgesloten, maar gedurende de hele looptijd ook daadwerkelijk waarde leveren? En krijg jij energie van leveranciers uitdagen, risico’s beheersen en samen met de business sturen op prestaties en verbetering? Kies dan voor Univé!

Wie zijn wij?

Het mooie van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de resultaten, de geschiedenis, de cultuur, het ontstaan en de betrokkenheid. Dat is samenwerken. Een coöperatie zijn zonder winstoogmerk. Dicht bij onze leden staan. En samen bouwen aan een organisatie die betrouwbaar, toekomstbestendig en wendbaar is.

Wij richten ons op het voorkomen van risico’s, het beperken van gevolgen en we verzekeren alleen als het echt nodig is. Coöperatie Univé bestaat uit zeven verschillende Regionale Univé’s, zodat we op landelijk én lokaal niveau altijd dichtbij onze leden zijn. Dat is het mooie van Univé.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Inkoop & Facilitaire Zaken, in het team Inkoop & Contractmanagement. Dit team voert binnen Univé de regie op inkoop-, contract- en leveranciersmanagement. Ons doel? Grip op uitgaven en risico’s, professionele en efficiënte processen én optimale ondersteuning van de business.

We zijn volop in ontwikkeling. Inkoop & Contractmanagement groeit verder naar een professionele, businessgerichte en datagedreven regiepartner. Dat betekent dat we niet alleen kijken naar wat er contractueel is afgesproken, maar vooral ook naar de waarde die contracten en leveranciers gedurende de looptijd daadwerkelijk voor Univé realiseren.

Als contractmanager speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt intensief samen met contracteigenaren, management, inkopers, Risk, Compliance en Juridische Zaken. En natuurlijk met onze leveranciers.

Jouw uitdaging

Als contractmanager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren en bewaken van contractwaarde gedurende de volledige looptijd van onze contracten.
Je voert regie op het contract- en leveranciersmanagement van de aan jou toegewezen contracten en leveranciers. Daarbij stuur je op naleving van afspraken, kosten, kwaliteit, risico’s, performance, compliance en duurzaamheid.

Je zorgt ervoor dat Univé grip houdt op de ingekochte dienstverlening en dat afspraken niet alleen op papier goed geregeld zijn, maar in de praktijk ook worden nagekomen.

Daarbij ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor zowel de business als leveranciers. Je organiseert en leidt leveranciersoverleggen, maakt prestaties en risico’s inzichtelijk en zorgt dat acties daadwerkelijk worden opgevolgd. Zie je afwijkingen, kansen of risico’s? Dan wacht je niet af, maar kom je in actie.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • regie voeren op complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten;

  • sturen op contractnaleving, kosten, kwaliteit, performance, risico’s, compliance en duurzaamheid;

  • organiseren en leiden van leveranciersoverleggen;

  • bewaken van SLA’s, KPI’s, afspraken en verbetermaatregelen;

  • begeleiden van wijzigingen, indexaties, evaluaties, verlengingen en beëindigingen;

  • signaleren en beheersen van contractuele, leveranciers- en continuïteitsrisico’s;

  • initiëren en begeleiden van verbeterplannen, disputen en escalaties;

  • ondersteunen van contracteigenaren en management bij besluitvorming over contracten en leveranciers;

  • opstellen van analyses en managementrapportages over contractstatus, prestaties, risico’s, acties en besluitpunten;

  • tijdig signaleren wanneer hercontractering of een nieuwe marktbenadering nodig is;

  • bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé.

De inhoudelijke beoordeling van de dienstverlening ligt primair bij de business en contracteigenaar. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze prestaties periodiek worden beoordeeld en voert regie op de contractuele borging, opvolging en eventuele escalatie. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan één overleg of één contractmoment.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een contractmanager die regie pakt. Je brengt structuur, houdt overzicht en weet wanneer je moet verbinden, adviseren, onderhandelen of juist escaleren.

Je voelt je comfortabel in een omgeving waarin verschillende belangen samenkomen. Je kunt schakelen tussen de dagelijkse praktijk en tactisch-strategische vraagstukken en bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor contracteigenaren, management en leveranciers.

Je bent analytisch en risicobewust, maar vooral ook gericht op resultaat. Een contract is voor jou geen statisch document: je gebruikt het als instrument om prestaties te verbeteren, risico’s te beheersen en waarde voor Univé te realiseren.

Je bouwt aan professionele leveranciersrelaties waarin transparantie, voorspelbaarheid, continue verbetering en wederzijdse aanspreekbaarheid centraal staan. Je durft leveranciers uit te dagen en weet tegelijkertijd hoe je een constructieve langetermijnrelatie onderhoudt.

Verder breng je mee:

  • HBO/HBO+ werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in bedrijfskunde, rechten, economie of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring binnen contractmanagement, bij voorkeur domein IT;

  • aantoonbare ervaring met complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten en leveranciers, binnen het domein IT;

  • kennis van contract lifecycle management, leveranciersrelatiemanagement, prestatiesturing en contractgovernance;

  • ervaring met leveranciersoverleggen, prestatiebeoordelingen, contractevaluaties en escalatiemanagement;

  • kennis van risicomanagement, compliance-eisen en interne beheersing;

  • kennis van relevante wet- en regelgeving en uitbestedingskaders;

  • bij voorkeur een aanvullende opleiding op het gebied van contractmanagement, zoals CATS, NEVI 2 of vergelijkbaar.

Daarnaast herkennen we in jou initiatief, regievoering, risicobewustzijn en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent communicatief sterk, kwaliteitsgericht en analytisch, kunt goed samenwerken en beschikt over overtuigingskracht en onderhandelingsvaardigheden op tactisch-strategisch niveau.

Wat bieden wij?

We vragen veel van je, maar daar geven we je ook graag veel voor terug:

  • een salaris passend bij jouw kennis, opleiding en ervaring op basis van een 38-urige werkweek, inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand;

  • een collectieve prestatiebeloning;

  • een arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • een studiekostenregeling en volop ruimte om jezelf professioneel verder te ontwikkelen;

  • een goede pensioenvoorziening;

  • hybride werken: thuiswerken is bij ons heel normaal en je hebt de vrijheid om samen met je team je ideale werkplek te bepalen;

  • een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding op de dagen dat je vanuit huis werkt;

Maar minstens zo belangrijk: je krijgt bij ons ruimte om impact te maken. Contract- en leveranciersmanagement is binnen Univé volop in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt daarmee de mogelijkheid om niet alleen contracten professioneel te managen, maar ook actief bij te dragen aan hoe we ons vakgebied verder vormgeven.

jobs.description:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

jobs.title: Interim Chief Privacy Officer | RVO
jobs.description:
Omschrijving

Wij zijn voor de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO) op zoek naar een ervaren Interim Chief Privacy Officer (CPO). Binnen de afdeling CIP speel je een sleutelrol in het verder ontwikkelen en professionaliseren van de privacyfunctie binnen een grote en complexe overheidsorganisatie.

Vanwege het vertrek van de huidige plaatsvervangend CPO is tijdelijke versterking nodig om de continuïteit van de privacyorganisatie te waarborgen. Op termijn wordt de functie structureel ingevuld. In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder inrichten en uitbouwen van de CPO-functie, het versterken van de privacy governance en het adviseren van management bij complexe privacyvraagstukken.

Je begeleidt en stuurt privacyfunctionarissen functioneel aan, verbindt verschillende stakeholders binnen de organisatie en draagt actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van privacy, compliance en gegevensbescherming.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Verder ontwikkelen, inrichten en positioneren van de Chief Privacy Officer-functie.

  • Functioneel aansturen van privacyfunctionarissen en privacyaanspreekpunten binnen de organisatie.

  • Adviseren van hoger management over complexe privacyvraagstukken.

  • Opstellen, uitvoeren en bewaken van het privacyplan.

  • Doorontwikkelen van privacy governance, privacybeleid en bijbehorende processen.

  • Uitvoeren, begeleiden en beoordelen van Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIA's).

  • Deelnemen aan strategische en tactische overleggen op het gebied van privacy en gegevensbescherming.

  • Begeleiden van privacy-audits, onderzoeken en opvolging van verbetermaatregelen.


Wat vragen wij?

Eisen

  • Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding op het gebied van gegevensbescherming, privacy of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Minimaal 2,5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring als Chief Privacy Officer (CPO) of plaatsvervangend CPO binnen de Rijksoverheid.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met de toepassing van privacywetgeving, waaronder de AVG, binnen grote organisaties met meer dan 1.000 medewerkers.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met functionele aansturing van privacyfunctionarissen of privacyadviseurs.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen of doorontwikkelen van privacy governance en privacybeleid.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het adviseren van hoger management over privacyvraagstukken.

Pré

  • Relevante privacycertificering, zoals CIPP/E of CIPM.

  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren of beoordelen van DPIA's.

  • Ervaring met het opzetten, vastleggen, inrichten en vervullen van een CPO-functie.

  • Ervaring met privacygerelateerde audits en onderzoeken.

  • Ervaring met Privacy by Design binnen organisatieprocessen of digitale producten.

  • Kennis van en/of ervaring met de EU AI Act en de relatie tussen AI-governance en privacy.

Competenties

  • Overtuigend en verbindend.

  • Bestuurlijk en organisatiesensitief.

  • Analytisch en doortastend.

  • Integer en onafhankelijk in de oordeelsvorming.

Informatie 

Opdrachtduur: 7 maanden met optie verlengen

Locatie: Den Haag, met werkzaamheden in Utrecht en Zwolle en deels hybride

Inzet: 24 tot 36 uur per week (voorkeur voor 32 uur per week(

Contractvorm: ZZP

Start: Zo spoedig mogelijk

Geïnteresseerd?

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME)

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk

  • Vakantiegeld 8%

  • CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar

  • Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00

  • Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft

  • Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team

  • Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel

  • Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities


Wat ga je doen:

  • Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley.

  • Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel)

  • Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT

  • Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues

  • Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen

  • Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen.

  • Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak

  • Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten


  • HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring

  • Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000

  • Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA)

  • Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig

  • Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal)

In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken?

Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst.

We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt.

Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent.

Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken.
